tasks.short: Set the payoff order, then apply it.

steps.what: List stored balances and creditor names
Devise debt liquidation plans and payoff priorities
Set the timelines for that payoff order
Sign the payoff order
Apply only the signed payoff order
outputs: filed copy of signed payoff order v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} lists stored balances and creditor names and does not choose an order. The advisor devises the debt liquidation plan, sets the payoff priorities and the timelines, and signs that order. A later job applies only the signed order to the stored balances. A blank priority is not applied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Payoff order was recalculated whenever a balance moved, without a signed priority.
tasks.enabler_now: Balance identifier, balance amount, and creditor name are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Debt advice stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor sets the payoff order.

ambition.what: Sign the debt plan the day a stored balance changes.

tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the priorities, not on listing balances.

reach.task: Receive only what the signed order names

evidence.claim: The executive digest says these figures are plain code and configuration in the ledger.
The executive digest says interviews, debt advice, and declining excessive risk stay with people.

assumptions: Balance identifier, balance amount, and creditor name are stored on the debt record. The debt record produces them. A blank balance is not treated as zero. A blank priority is not applied. The advisor sets the payoff order before the job applies it.
Native configuration of the debt record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
The job applies only the order the advisor signed.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor devising debt liquidation plans and payoff priorities.

incremental.description: Refresh balance identifier, balance amount, and creditor name when the debt layout changes, and drop an order the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many priorities are blank. The high end assumes balance amount and the advisor's priority are both stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Open the account and sign the release.

steps.what: List creditor amounts with no credit score
Open accounts for clients and act as agent
Decide how to disburse funds to creditors
Sign the disbursement
Release only the signed disbursement
outputs: filed copy of signed disbursement v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} lists creditor amounts and writes no credit score. The advisor opens the account, acts as agent for the client, and decides the disbursement. A later job in {BANK} releases only that signed disbursement. It does not open the account by itself and it does not assess creditworthiness. The release is a new job of the signed amount, not an existing payment run.
tasks.previous_blocker: Money moved before the advisor had signed the amount.
tasks.enabler_now: Account identifier, creditor name, and disbursement amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Opening the account and choosing the amount stay with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides the amount and that it may be released.

ambition.what: Sign the disbursement the day the creditor amount and the stored balance are both present.

tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the decision, not on listing creditors.

reach.task: Receive only the disbursement the advisor signed

evidence.claim: Digest [S12] says credit scoring of natural persons is high-risk, and life and health insurance pricing is high-risk. This design does not score a client and does not price insurance.
Digest [S13] says the high-risk duties apply from 2 December 2027.
Digest [S15] says a score is an automated decision when the lender gives it a determining role. This design does not produce a score.
The executive digest says firms fall outside and sole traders do not. This design does not score a client either way.
Digest [S16] and [S17] say that from 20 November 2026 consumers may demand human review and an explanation of automated creditworthiness assessments. This design does not assess creditworthiness.

assumptions: Account identifier, creditor name, and disbursement amount are stored on the account record. The account record produces them. A blank amount is not treated as zero. The job does not open the account by itself and does not assess creditworthiness.
Native configuration of the account record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
The release is the signed disbursement and no other amount.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor opening accounts for clients and acting as agent.

incremental.description: Refresh account identifier, creditor name, and disbursement amount when the account layout changes, and drop a disbursement the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many disbursement amounts are blank. The high end assumes creditor name and disbursement amount are both stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inform the client from the stored rule.

steps.what: List the stored benefit rule and nothing else
Inform clients about government rebates and other benefits
Explain alternative-fuel purchases and energy-efficient remodeling
Sign the benefit note
File the signed benefit note
outputs: filed copy of signed benefit note v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists the stored benefit rule. The advisor informs the client about tax benefits, government rebates, and other benefits of alternative-fuel vehicle purchases or energy-efficient home construction, improvements, or remodeling. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not file a rebate or a tax return, and it does not quote a blank rule.
tasks.previous_blocker: Benefit rules were quoted from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: Benefit rule identifier and rule text are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The explanation stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides which stored rule applies.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the explanation, not on listing rules.

reach.task: Rely only on the benefit note the advisor signed

evidence.claim: The advisor informs the client from a stored rule. The job does not file a rebate or a tax return.

assumptions: Benefit rule identifier and rule text are stored on the rule record. The rule record produces them. A blank rule is not quoted. The job does not file a rebate or a tax return.
Native configuration of the rule record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

incremental.description: Refresh benefit rule identifier and rule text when the rule layout changes, and drop a note the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many rule texts are blank. The high end assumes benefit rule identifier and rule text are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.short: Recommend responsible funds without a rank.

steps.what: List cleantech and alternative energy facts with no rank
Recommend environmentally responsible investments in person
Judge conservation technologies, companies, and funds
Sign the investment recommendation
File the signed investment recommendation
outputs: filed copy of signed investment recommendation v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} lists stored facts for cleantech, alternative energy, and conservation and writes no rank. The advisor recommends the environmentally responsible investments, including companies and funds. A later job files the signed recommendation in {DOCS}. It does not rank a fund and it does not score the client.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fund facts were remembered rather than read from the record.
tasks.enabler_now: Fund identifier and stored fact are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The recommendation stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides whether the fund fits.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the recommendation, not on listing funds.

reach.task: Hear only the recommendation the advisor signed

evidence.claim: The advisor recommends the investment. The list is not a rank and not a score of the client.

assumptions: Fund identifier and stored fact are stored on the fund record. The fund record produces them. The list is not a rank. A blank fact is not a recommendation. The job does not score the client.
Native configuration of the fund record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor recommending environmentally responsible investments.

incremental.description: Refresh fund identifier and stored fact when the fund layout changes, and drop a recommendation the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many stored facts are blank. The high end assumes fund identifier and stored fact are present. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

role.altitude: The advisor spends the week with the client and on the signed note. A stored ratio, a missing-field list, and filing that signature can move. The advisor still interviews, recommends, and decides.
reach: A client receives only the text the advisor signed.
A creditor is paid only the disbursement the advisor signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a ratio that treats a blank figure as zero.
Reject a report whose figure has no source row.
Reject a payment the advisor has not signed.
